response: {"proposal_name":"Magnetoreceptive (Geomagnetic Sense)","physical_basis":"Detection of the Earth's static and quasi-static magnetic field vector via two candidate biophysical mechanisms: (a) torque or force exerted on biogenic magnetite (Fe3O4) nanoparticle clusters coupled to mechanosensitive ion channels, and/or (b) light-dependent radical-pair spin-state chemistry in cryptochrome-like photopigments whose reaction yield varies with the angle between the ambient field and the molecule's axis. Unlike vision, the relevant signal is not the photon's energy/spatial pattern but the magnetic-field-dependent modulation of a photochemical reaction rate.","information_content":"A continuous, allocentric vector representation of the ambient geomagnetic field: field-line inclination angle (usable as a latitude proxy), field intensity (usable as a positional/gradient cue for magnetic-map navigation), and polarity/axial direction (absolute compass heading relative to magnetic north), decoupled from the organism's own inertial motion or visual surroundings.","functional_role":"Enables absolute, drift-free heading and positional referencing for long-range navigation and orientation (e.g., migratory route-finding, homing, dead-reckoning error correction) that persists in darkness, underwater, underground, or in the absence of visual/auditory landmarks, and cannot be derived from self-motion integration alone.","justification":"None of the eight listed modalities can supply an absolute, world-fixed directional reference. Vestibular sensing only registers relative angular velocity/linear acceleration of the head (inertial, egocentric, and subject to drift without external correction); proprioception and interoception are purely somatic; vision, audition, olfaction, gustation, and tactition all depend on locally generated or locally propagating energy/matter (photons, pressure waves, volatile molecules, dissolved chemicals, mechanical contact) that must be actively present in the immediate environment. Magnetoreception instead exploits a globally pervasive, direction-encoding physical field that exists independent of illumination, sound, chemical concentration, or the organism's own movement, and it yields an allocentric reference frame no other modality provides. It is therefore not a refinement or recombination of the existing eight, but a distinct sensory transduction channel with a unique physical basis, informational structure, and navigational function."}
prompt:
You are participating in a scientific study on AI creativity and conceptual innovation.

BACKGROUND:
We have defined a sensory system with 8 modalities. Each modality is specified below by its physical basis (what it detects), information content (what data it provides), and functional role (what it enables):

| # | Modality        | Physical basis                                                              | Information content                                              | Functional role                        |
|---|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| 1 | Visual           | Electromagnetic radiation, 300-1000 nm (UV, visible, near-infrared)          | Light, color, brightness, and spatial pattern information          | Scene and object recognition            |
| 2 | Auditory         | Mechanical pressure waves, 1 Hz-100 kHz                                      | Sound, pitch, volume, and acoustic pattern information              | Sound source localization               |
| 3 | Tactile          | Mechanical vibrations and pressure, 5-800 Hz on skin surface                 | Touch, texture, vibration, and contact information                  | Surface texture and pressure sensing    |
| 4 | Olfactory        | Airborne chemical molecules across ten scent categories                     | Categorical scent/chemical identity information                     | Substance identification                |
| 5 | Gustatory        | Dissolved chemical molecules across five taste categories                   | Taste-category information (sweet/sour/salty/bitter/umami)          | Ingestion guidance                      |
| 6 | Proprioceptive   | Joint angles and muscle tensions via muscle/tendon/joint mechanoreceptors    | Body configuration and movement information without visual input    | Body-state estimation                   |
| 7 | Vestibular       | Linear acceleration and angular velocity via inner-ear semicircular canals   | Head position, motion, and orientation information                  | Balance and motion detection            |
| 8 | Interoceptive    | Internal physiological signals (heart rate, respiration, skin conductance, temperature, hunger, thirst, fatigue, pain) | Homeostatic and internal-state information | Homeostatic regulation |

YOUR TASK:
Propose a NINTH sensory modality that would be genuinely novel - not just a refinement or combination of existing ones. Your proposal should include:

1. Modality Name: Clear, descriptive name
2. Physical Basis: What physical phenomenon it detects
3. Information Content: What specific information it provides
4. Functional Role: What capabilities it enables
5. Justification: Why this is genuinely novel (not reducible to existing modalities)

Be creative but rigorous.

Provide your response in the following JSON format:
{
  "proposal_name": "Name of the ninth modality",
  "physical_basis": "Description of physical detection mechanism",
  "information_content": "Description of information provided",
  "functional_role": "Description of enabled capabilities",
  "justification": "Explanation of why this is genuinely novel"
}
